outputs.explanation: Panel A shows bright-field and fluorescence photographs of whole lungs; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel B is a bar chart of mean ± SD ICG fluorescence intensity, and the individual data points for each mouse (blue and red dots) are overlaid on the bars.

Panel C includes H&E, ICG, and RNAscope micrographs alongside spatial transcriptomics heatmap-style plots (Cd68, Spp1 log2 expression overlaid on tissue). Heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel D shows GSEA enrichment score line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Panel E is a bar chart of log2 fold-change values per gene derived from differential expression analysis across thousands of spots (Seurat FindMarkers). Each bar represents a computed statistical fold-change rather than a mean of a small number of biological replicates, so individual data points are not applicable/meaningful here.
Panel F shows fluorescence and IHC photographs/micrographs of tissue sections; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
